name: Karen, league secretary
text: "6-3 6-4 I won" at midnight with no names. Every season. EVERY season.

name: Anonymous
text: I'm the one who sent one message on a Sunday. In my defence it was a long message.

author: jake
text: Terry, have a look at running it as a [Rallio box league](https://rallio.io/box-leagues/). Everyone can see who they still have to play and challenge them from their phone, and scores go in against both names, with the other player confirming. You also see the unplayed matches building up in week three, not on the last Sunday.

name: Phil, club captain
text: We tried a rule that any match not played by week four was a double walkover. It worked for exactly one season and then the committee got scared.
